stops.note: became the name of a sweet milk-based rice pudding
stops.meaning: a sweet rice pudding made with milk

stops.note: adopted in English food writing on South Asian desserts
stops.meaning: a sweet pudding of rice, milk, and sugar, often flavored with cardamom

current_meaning: A sweet South Asian dessert of rice (or vermicelli) simmered in milk with sugar and cardamom.
